metadata.name: GetAccountDetails
metadata.description: Fetches account details to be displayed on panel.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DebitWriteOffDate
children.description: Date when Debit was written off on account

children.name: CreditWriteOnDate
children.description: Date when Credit Write on happened on account

children.name: ExceededPastDueDaysPermitted
children.description: Days permitted on account for payment after Due days Allowable Values: 10

children.name: RegulationOFlag
children.description: Regulation O flag of account.

children.name: RegulationOFlagEffectiveDate
children.description: Date when Regulation O was effective on account

children.name: AutoPayIndicator
children.description: Indicator showing if account is registered for Autopay for payment Allowable Values: 5

children.name: CoOwnerExists
children.description: Indicates the Secondary Card Co-Owner exists in relation to the Primary Card Valid Values: 0 - No and 1 -Yes Example: 0

children.name: HoldDaysApplicableonAccount
children.description: Payment Hold days applicable on account Valid Values:0-9 Example: 2

children.name: BypassExistingPaymentHoldLogic
children.description: Account Payment Hold days set up by bypassing the existing payment hold days logic Valid Values: 0-No, 1-Yes Example: yes/No

children.name: OptOutofPenaltyPricing
children.description: Indicates if customer has opted to out of penalty pricing or not. If it is set to ‘Yes’, it means penalty pricing was applied but customer has opted out of it. ‘No’ means customer has not opted out of it. Null means account is not in penalty pricing. Valid Values: Yes/No/Null Example: Yes Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AssociationProductType
children.description: Indicates the Association Product Type, if its MC or some value and what sub type of association product For entire list of valid values, please refer to Appendix document Example:MWE (Mastercard World Elite Allowable Values: 100

children.name: RewardID
children.description: Indicates Reward Program ID Allowable Values: 25

children.name: GracePaymentDueDate
children.description: Adjusted payment due date when Payment due date falls on a Weekend. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/dd/yyyy Example:01/15/2022

children.name: MinimumPaymentDue
children.description: This tag Indicates the minimum payment due for the card Valid Values:0-9 Example:100.05

children.name: LastStatementBalance
children.description: Indicates the last statement balance for the card Valid Values:0-9 Example:100.05

children.name: DaysDelinquent
children.description: Indicates the days delinquent Valid Values:0-9 Example:10

children.name: StatementRemainingBalanceWithMonthlyInstallment
children.description: It gives 100% revolving balance + monthly installment due Valid Values:0-9 Example:100.05

children.name: RevolvingCreditLimit
children.description: Indicates the credit limit capping for revolving plans, when revolving plan capping is defined on the program. Valid Values:0-9 Example:$500.00

children.name: RevolvingPlanOpenToBuy
children.description: Indicates the open to buy for revolving plans,when revolving plan capping is defined on the program. Valid Values:0-9 Example:$500.00

children.name: LinkedAccountNumber
children.description: Desciption: Indicates the linked account number having the same CustomerID. Valid Values:0-9, a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Desciption: Unique ID associated with customer. Valid Values: 0-9, a-z Format: XXXXXXXX Example:ABC2123 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: IsTemporaryCreditLimitActive
children.description: This tag specifies if a Temporary Credit Limit is Active on an Account or not. Valid Values : 0 - No 1 - Yes Format: X Example: 1

children.name: TemporaryCreditLimitExpirationDate
children.description: The ExpirationDate on which the credit limit will reset to original credit limit. If no temporary credit limit is active, this field will be blank. Valid Values: Format: MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example:02/11/2017 23:59:58

children.name: FallbackCreditLimit
children.description: The credit limit to which the Account will revert to post expiration date. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXX.XX Example: 500.00
